title: Steel plate for the reserve bought docked at Central Nexus at the 18 cr ask and stored there (Logistics' haulers, standing work at home)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-24 07:27 UTC (orders ENT-085 block APOLLO: no hauler waits docked; P2: steel for the builds; rules F8, F23, F24, F36). At 07:25 UTC 11 haulers waited docked at Nexus Prime at the end of the paid Sol loop, and the fill gate warned of 90 ships on once-only routes without a repeating fallback. The reserve is short of 36,466 steel plate (tool needs action=items, 07:27 UTC); Central Nexus asks 18 cr x 4,187 (depth 13,770, table books 07:27 UTC); Node Beta, The Experiment and Node Alpha ask 18 in depth too. Each run buys one hold of plate (65 on a Threshold) and stores it at Central Nexus, 1 jump from Node Beta where the Atria kit and the offices are built: docked, no fuel. Standing (a buy for the reserve is judged on no pay, skill step 22); requires.ask keeps it to the 18 cr ask; the reserve gate (F36) closes it at the steel max. max_ships 3 for the first runs (rule F37); lifted when their RESULT lines show the plate stored. 2026-11-24 07:32 UTC (Apollo): off: the dispatcher classes a circuit that buys and does not craft as trade, traders' work under strict classes (why_closed.py: 'class: trade is traders' work'); replaced by craft-steel-bought-iron-central-nexus. 2026-11-24 10:03 UTC (Apollo): on again by Unity's answer requests.log ENT-504 (option a): a docked buy that only stores for the reserve is reserve keeping, Logistics' job; a buy that feeds a sale stays Trade's. open_to hauler is the Admiral's exception under rule F23 with that answer as its reason. Lean (F36): max_price 20, requires.ask 19 with depth 65, max_ships 3 within the ask's depth (4,173 at Central Nexus, table books 10:03 UTC), and requires.held_below steel_plate 90,000 of Logistics: the division held 83,540 plate (tool stock 10:01 UTC), so the route closes after about 6,460 more; the fleet's net short of plate for the open needs is 31,603 (needs.py items 10:01 UTC), and our own iron goes to steel first (orders P2), so the gate is lifted only by a turn that reads the craft routes' figures. 2026-11-24 10:13 UTC (Apollo): first runs 10:08-10:11 UTC bought 65 plate in 0.5 min for 1,181 cr each (runs.jsonl): about 130 runs an hour a ship, faster than the storage book's 40-minute reading that feeds held_below; max_ships 1 and units 88,000 bound what the lag can overshoot.
